summary: Comprehensive backend+frontend test of CarPlayYouTube. Backend graceful-error endpoints all pass (6/6). Frontend home, search overlay, friendly search error, queue, IFrame player, controls (play/pause, next/prev, mute, progress/duration), settings (toggles, fit modes, clear queue/recent), car mode, auto-hide, portrait notice, responsive from 1920x1080 down to 1024x400 and mobile landscape 844x390 all work. One real UI z-index bug: the dismissible key-banner (bottom-4 z-[55]) overlaps the ControlBar region and intercepts pointer events, making play-pause/mute/etc unclickable until the banner is dismissed.

ui_bugs.issue: The 'Live search is off...' banner is absolutely positioned at bottom-4 with z-[55] directly over the ControlBar area. Playwright reports 'subtree intercepts pointer events' on [data-testid="play-pause-btn"]. Real users won't be able to click play/pause/mute/fullscreen without first dismissing the banner. Move it out of the control-bar footprint (e.g., top of player, or lower z-index than control-bar, or auto-dismiss when a video is active).
The dismiss (X) button inside key-banner has no data-testid. Add data-testid="key-banner-dismiss" per spec expectations.

action_items: Fix key-banner z-index/positioning so it does not overlap/intercept the ControlBar region (users cannot click play-pause until banner dismissed).
Add data-testid="key-banner-dismiss" to the banner's X button for testability.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: good — graceful 503 API_KEY_MISSING, no stack traces, no 500s observed.
CarPlayer.jsx is 592 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold; consider splitting (player hooks, keyboard shortcuts, overlays) if it grows.
key-banner overlaps ControlBar — classic z-index/placement bug; worth fixing before more features are added.

Seed videos recommended in the test playbook include M7lc1UVf-VE (YT Dev Live) which is a live/ended stream and shows 'video cannot be played' — consider updating the playbook to a reliably embeddable video (e.g., dQw4w9WgXcQ or jNQXAC9IVRw).

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (one HIGH z-index bug, all flows otherwise functional)

seed_data_creation: LocalStorage seeded with cpyt:queue containing dQw4w9WgXcQ and jNQXAC9IVRw plus cpyt:visited=true to bypass home screen; cpyt:keyBannerDismissed used only to work around the overlapping banner during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green with YOUTUBE_API_KEY empty. Known UI bug: key-banner intercepts clicks on control-bar — dismiss it (or wait for fix) before testing playback controls. #yt-player gets REPLACED by the <iframe> itself (same id), so to assert iframe creation check `document.getElementById('yt-player').tagName === 'IFRAME'` rather than `#yt-player iframe`. The playbook seed video M7lc1UVf-VE is unreliable; prefer dQw4w9WgXcQ + jNQXAC9IVRw.
rca of the issue: key-banner is rendered inside the main player container with `absolute bottom-4 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-[55]`. The ControlBar also sits at the bottom of the same container (lower z-index). Because the banner's wrapper spans across the ControlBar's footprint, it captures pointer events on the play/pause button area. Mitigation: either (a) raise ControlBar z-index above 55 and ensure the banner only occupies non-interactive space, (b) position the banner at top-4 or shift it horizontally off the control cluster, or (c) auto-hide the banner once a video starts playing.
